name: Pilfering Pirates
desc:
Team up with your crewmates to destroy and sink enemy pirates!
Be careful not to let your ship get destroyed!

Collect gold to buy new boats, planes, skins, and more!
Want some extra gold? Join Pseudostudio for 2000 FREE gold!

PRIVATE SERVERS: 4 players are required to start a game!

Pilfering Pirates is a Brickbattle destruction fighting game inspired by Black Pearl vs Flying Dutchman and Doomspire Brickbattle

Latest version : 2.13.11
